messages:
mike: Heads-up — small UX + telemetry ask for the autofallback flow. Proposal: surface an 'escalation breadcrumb' panel in the rollout policy UI that shows the chain of signals that caused the fallback (errors, latency spike, model mismatch, quota). Quick mock coming. Want to align on fields we need in telemetry before I start.

sarah: +1 from product. We need something digestible for PMs and support. Key asks: readable reason, latency at trigger, active model, fallback model, estimated user-impact. Also need a permanent audit link to logs.

josh: runtime note — we already emit traces and error events, but they aren't mapped to rollout config IDs. We can emit a compact trace id and a list of trigger events (e.g., latency=1200ms, error=502, kv_miss=true). Adding mapping to rollout_id is doable; will require a small proto change.

lex: eng-sre — this is important for postmortems. Please include a severity field and a sampled_payload_id so we can pull a replayable sample. Also define TTL for breadcrumb records.

mike: Thinking default TTL 30d, UI shows most recent 7 days by default. Proposed data fields: trace_id, triggers, trigger_ts, src_model, fallback_model, route, rollout_id, severity, sampled_payload_id. Any missing items?

ana: ops-bot chiming in — make sure deploy notifications can link directly to the breadcrumb entry. Also reminder: sampled payloads must be scrubbed for PII before storage.

josh: Agree on fields. Proposed schema names: trace_id, triggers (CSV or small array), trig_ts, src_model, fallback_model, route, rollout_id, severity, sample_id. No objections to 30d retention from runtime side.

sarah: UX side: top-level summary line in console (reason, time, severity, models) with an expandable timeline of events underneath. Add a hover that translates trigger codes to human text. Also want a rollout_id filter in the console table.

mike: Two quick ownership questions before I begin drafting API + mock: 1) who owns the storage/retention (observability infra vs rollout service)? 2) Is sampled payload accessible by default or gated behind a permission?

lex: Observability infra should own retention and indexing — they have the capacity and lifecycle tooling. Rollout UI will query the catalog to resolve rollout_id -> config. Sampled payloads behind permission, redacted by default, and require a short approval workflow to unredact.

josh: I'll open a small PR adding the proto fields and basic mapping. Will tag @sarah and @lex for review.

mike: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll post mock screenshots and an API sketch tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
